objective: Preserve original correct decisions while improving condition robustness, retaining the statistics/precision/shared-cost thesis question
authorization: User approved two bounded training methods and requests reflection, traceable design rationale and Git backup

data.representation: proxy with previous train-frozen per-feature scales; 21 slots held fixed for control, not optimum claim
data.historical_test: No new scoring, split metadata only
data.reserve_audit: All five sequences absent from historical binary manifest: identity/annotation coverage only, no model scoring or choice based on accuracy; historical nonuse remains to be established

training.selection: Final epoch60, all seeds; no best checkpoint, no parameter search
training.normalization: Same train-only mixture mean/std and frozen QAT calibration as previous augmentation proxy
training.teacher: Same-seed clean-trained proxy from mechanism factorial_v2 epoch60. Offline train-only logits, no validation selection; teacher forward compute recorded separately
training.clean_guard: Class-weighted CE plus correct-teacher clean-view KL, temperature2, coefficient1, weighted over entire batch; wrong teacher and perturbed views receive zero distillation penalty
training.group_guard: Same clean guard plus 0.5 ordinary weighted CE + 0.5 group-weighted CE; 18 groups = 3 views x 3 source-history bins (0,1..5,6 preceding observations) x 2 source-current-point bins (train median boundary); group q starts uniform, epoch multiplicative update eta0.05 on per-group weighted CE; no validation feedback
training.group_definitions: Group source observation support before synthetic removal, not inferred post-removal history; no new runtime metadata inputs
training.compute: Same one sampled view per row per epoch and one student forward/backward; teacher train inference additional offline cost, task loss aggregation overhead reported; previous A/B reused as controls

evaluation.groups: Original supported point-count, shape and cross groups; real sparse current points/history/range; >=100 rows, >=3 sequences, both labels

acceptance.interpretation: Exploratory development gate, not safety guarantee; failure means no promoted method. All supported groups reported even outside protected gate

evaluation.bootstrap: Whole sequence paired 2000 resamples, exploratory, no selection or multiplicity correction

stop: Stop after six completed trajectories or any numerical/integer mismatch/budget exhaustion. No extra variants or seeds to rescue hypothesis.
review: One-executor pre-run method/code review and Python preflight, not independent review. Previously viewed validation is explicitly exploratory. Distillation/group DRO are known methods; no new-method claim.
